node.title: Trabajo compensatorio evitable (ACW)
node.summary: People move, repair or reconcile information to compensate for a remediable gap.

relations: The task-level protocol operationalizes the earlier role-based framework; its time ratios should not be compared with operator ratios without an explicit conversion model.
Es desarrollo del instrumento descrito, no prueba de que el constructo ya esté validado. No mezclar poblaciones ni reetiquetar retrospectivamente los resultados.
The oversight-threshold study tests whether added review and reconciliation outweigh removed work, rather than treating guardrail count as a measure of debt.
No todos los controles aumentan carga ni la carga necesaria es deuda. La forma en U y el umbral no se presuponen observados.
Capability multiplicity is a screening signal; avoidable compensatory work must still be established from task episodes and a credible replacement counterfactual.
Una suite modular o redundancia deliberada puede ser adecuada. No clasificar todo cambio de ventana o exportación como desperdicio.
The forecast becomes testable by asking whether automation creates more compensatory work in processes already dependent on off-map reconciliation.
Es pronóstico condicionado. Cambios de volumen, regulación, demanda y riesgo pueden explicar el trabajo nuevo.
A common decision core may reduce human-as-API work, provided the cost of maintaining and qualifying that core is included in the comparison.
No se ha medido aquí ese efecto y un repositorio central puede crear nuevas reconciliaciones.
Validated task measurement can strengthen intervention evidence without by itself upgrading a defined Tiger Team model to quantitatively managed maturity.
La autoevaluación publicada declara que no reclama niveles 4–5. No atribuir una certificación o un salto de madurez nuevo.
Reusable audit evidence provides a concrete setting for distinguishing avoidable reconstruction from necessary assurance, while measuring the net work of maintaining the shared evidence model.
No se presupone que la reutilización elimine controles ni que los porcentajes iniciales de cumplimiento midan deuda humana.
